title: The Turret Turns
text: For two seconds a turret on the perimeter turned its back on the dark and laid its sights on the Civilian Center. It held its fire. Then it turned back. {who} was on the wall and saw all of it.

choices.label: Tell the colony
choices.reply: You put it on every screen: the turret, the two seconds, and that you did not order it. Nobody sleeps well.

choices.label: Call it a sensor fault
choices.reply: "A sensor fault." {who} nods. They keep looking at the turret.
